gloss: for one's own exclusive use; personal; private

definitions.gloss: for one's own exclusive use; personal; private
definitions.explanation: Something designated for or reserved for one person's use only. Used as a noun or as a modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {自分専用|じぶんせんよう}のパソコンがほしい。
examples.english: I want my own personal computer.

examples.japanese: これは{自分専用|じぶんせんよう}のマグカップです。
{子供|こども}に{自分専用|じぶんせんよう}の{部屋|へや}を{与|あた}えることにした。
examples.english: We decided to give the child their own private room.

notes:
A compound meaning something exclusively for oneself. Emphasizes personal ownership or exclusive access, in contrast to shared items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自分専用|じぶんせんよう}の{部屋|へや}: one's own room
- {自分専用|じぶんせんよう}のパソコン: one's own computer
- {自分専用|じぶんせんよう}の{道具|どうぐ}: one's own tools
- {自分専用|じぶんせんよう}の{机|つくえ}: one's own desk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {専用|せんよう}: exclusive use — the base word, which can modify any owner (not just oneself)
- {個人用|こじんよう}: for individual use — more formal
- {私物|しぶつ}: personal belongings — refers to owned items rather than designated use

FORMS:
{自分|じぶん} (oneself) + {専用|せんよう} (exclusive use)
